description: Get full product details by PID (branded pricing; plus a `wholesale` block with unbranded, no-setup prices where plain stock is available). `locale` localises the product name, currency, pricing and URL (en-AU, en-US, en-NZ, de-DE, ja-JP); descriptions are English for all locales.
